note: Bare *Deus* four times (56:2, 6, 8, 12); the stylist asks *ó Deus* each time. The Latin has no *o*; D44 held the bare vocative in Ps 50 and left the psalter-wide ruling to you.
*fosso* (the fóvea row, apart from *lacus*, 7:16); the stylist hears a moat and asks *cova … e nela caíram*. *cova* is the option.

*Levanta-te, minha glória, levanta-te, saltério*: one verb to glory and instruments, so *tu*. The blind reader heard it said to God, clashing with *vós*; the *vós* reading is option 4. The instrument order is kept for 107:3.
